goal: Scaffold the Go module, DDD directory structure, Docker Compose, Makefile, initial migrations, and .gitignore. No Go code yet — just the skeleton and devops files.

tasks.name: Go module + DDD directory skeleton
tasks.action: Initialize Go module (github.com/codenogo/pfin, go 1.26). Create all directories per DDD structure. Add .gitkeep files to preserve empty dirs. Create .gitignore (Go standard + .env + .cnogo/memory.db). Create .env.example with placeholder config.
microSteps: Create go.mod with module github.com/codenogo/pfin and go 1.26
Create cmd/api/main.go with minimal main() that prints 'pfin starting'
Create all internal/ directories: accounting, household, identity, budgeting, debt, portfolio, reporting, importing — each with domain/ stub
Create internal/common/ with event/, auth/, server/ stubs
Create pkg/ with money/, currency/, scope/, errs/ stubs
Create .env.example with DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, PORT, ENV placeholders

tdd.reason: Pure scaffold — no logic to test. Verified by file existence checks.

tasks.name: Docker Compose + Makefile + migrations
tasks.action: Create docker-compose.yml with PostgreSQL 18 service. Create Makefile with standard targets. Create initial SQL migration files for extensions and event outbox table.
microSteps: Create docker-compose.yml: postgres:18 service (port 5432, volume, env vars from .env), app service (build from Dockerfile, depends_on postgres)
Create Makefile with targets: build, test, lint, run, migrate-up, migrate-down, migrate-create, docker-up, docker-down
Create 001_extensions.up.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;
Create 001_extensions.down.sql: DROP EXTENSION IF EXISTS pg_trgm; DROP EXTENSION IF EXISTS pgcrypto;

Create 002_event_outbox.up.sql: event_outbox table (id UUID, event_type TEXT, aggregate_type TEXT, aggregate_id UUID, payload JSONB, metadata JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ) with indexes
Create 002_event_outbox.down.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS event_outbox;

tdd.reason: Infrastructure files — Docker and SQL. Verified by file existence and content checks.

tasks.name: OpenAPI spec skeleton
tasks.action: Create minimal OpenAPI 3.1 spec with /health endpoint and info section. This serves as the starting point for all future endpoint definitions.
microSteps: Create api/openapi.yaml with OpenAPI 3.1.0, info (title: pfin API, version: 0.1.0, description), servers (localhost:8080)
Define GET /health endpoint: 200 response with JSON schema (status: string, uptime: string, database: string)

tdd.reason: YAML specification file — no executable logic.

commitMessage: feat(foundation): scaffold Go module, DDD directories, Docker, Makefile, migrations
